title: DecAthlete for SegaNet
native_title: デカスリート フォー セガネット
overview:
Staking their claim to the title "King of Athletes", the DecAthletes put on a dazzling show!

- Eight athletes brimming with personality. Use each one's specialty events to fight your way through all 10 events!
- Button mashing is everything! Timing decides the contest! Control your athlete just as you want with simple controls!
- Beautiful visuals using high-resolution mode. Polygons make immersive camera angles possible!

- 100-Meter Dash
- Long Jump
- Shot Put
- High Jump
- 400-Meter Race
- 110-Meter Hurdles
- Discus Throw
- Pole Vault
- Javelin Throw
- 1500-Meter Race

"キング・オブ・アスリート"の名をかけて、デカスリート達が華麗に舞う！

●個性あふれる8人の選手たち。それぞれの得意種目を生かして全10種目を闘い抜こう！
●連打が命！タイミングで勝負！簡単操作で選手を思い通りに操ろう！
●高解像モードを使用した美しい画面。ポリゴンの使用で臨場感あふれるカメラアングルが可能に！
